summary: Quashing of criminal proceedings under Section 482 Cr.PC; prima facie case for IPC offences 323,504,506,509,511; second accused's absence from incident; civil dispute vs criminal harassment; security personnel involvement; medical examination not conducted; NCR to FIR procedural validity; inherent powers of High Court; dismissal of quashing petitions upheld.
legal_provisions_cited: Indian Penal Code, 1860 s.323, s.504, s.506, s.509, s.511
Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 s.482, s.155(2)
final_judgment: Appeals dismissed; High Court order upholding criminal proceedings affirmed; quashing petitions rejected.
